name: Walmart Shadow-Anchored Retail Center
summary: Walmart Shadow-Anchored Retail Center is a community shopping destination in Keller, Texas, benefiting from the traffic draw of a nearby Walmart supercenter. The center serves the daily retail needs of northeast Tarrant County's growing suburban population with convenient access and neighborhood-focused tenants.
demographics: The Walmart Shadow-Anchored Retail Center serves the growing suburban community of Keller, Texas, attracting primarily middle-income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000. The trade area draws heavily from young professionals and established families with children, typically aged 30-55, who value convenience and value-oriented shopping. The center benefits from Keller's strong population growth and its position in the prosperous northeast Tarrant County corridor, with shoppers seeking everyday necessities and practical retail options in a convenient neighborhood setting.
description: Walmart Shadow-Anchored Retail Center is a community-focused shopping destination strategically located at 8653 North Beach Street in Keller, Texas, serving the thriving northeast Tarrant County market. As its name suggests, this retail center benefits from the substantial traffic draw of a nearby Walmart supercenter, creating a shadow-anchor effect that drives consistent customer flow to the surrounding retail tenants. The center's location in Keller, one of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex's most desirable suburban communities, positions it perfectly to serve the daily shopping needs of local families and professionals. With convenient access and ample parking, the center provides a practical shopping environment for residents seeking everyday goods and services close to home. The property maintains a solid 4.5-star rating from 30 reviews, reflecting its role as a reliable neighborhood retail hub in this growing Texas community.
